title: A greener school
success_statement: I can explain the five target items and use at least two of them in a helpful school message.

arcs.attention: Our class has used paper and an empty jar. Can both be useful again in the same way? Predict, then check.
arcs.relevance: Choose a place in your school where your class could reduce waste.
arcs.confidence: Study the five example cards. Try supported recognition, then hide the cards for recall. Hints and retries remain available.
arcs.satisfaction: Write a two-sentence message for your chosen school place. Explain how two target items help make the message useful.

recognition_tasks.prompt: A factory processes used paper so it can be made into new paper. Which verb fits?
recognition_tasks.feedback: Recycling processes a used material so it can be used again. Reusing means using an item again.

recognition_tasks.prompt: Aina keeps an empty jar and uses it as a pencil holder. Which verb best describes what she does?
recognition_tasks.feedback: She uses the same jar again for a new purpose, so she reuses it.

recognition_tasks.prompt: Our class uses fewer sheets of paper each week. Which verb means to make the amount smaller?
recognition_tasks.feedback: Reduce means make something less or smaller.

recognition_tasks.prompt: Which word means materials that are no longer needed and are thrown away?
recognition_tasks.feedback: Waste is material that is no longer needed and is thrown away.

recognition_tasks.prompt: Which word refers to the natural world, including land, water, plants and animals?
recognition_tasks.feedback: The environment is the natural world around us.

recall_tasks.prompt: to process used materials so they can be used again
recall_tasks.hint: Reveal the first letter or return to the example card. Record any hint use.
Reveal the first letter or return to the example card. Record any hint use.

recall_tasks.hint: Reveal the first letter or return to the example card. Record any hint use.

production_task.prompt: Write two sentences explaining how pupils can reduce waste in a place you choose at school. Use at least two target items.
production_task.example_response: We reuse jars to hold pencils. This helps us reduce waste.
production_task.assessment: Teacher checks that the selected items have the intended meaning and an appropriate form. Other meaningful answers are accepted.
